metadata.lesson: In this source and ASS rendering path, RLM U+200F alone retained incorrect Arabic numeric-prefix/equals order. An explicit RLE U+202B plus PDF U+202C corrected the inspected encoded numeral, connected Arabic phrase and equals order while retaining the color-coded result. Verify the encoded output rather than inferring success from direction markers.
